problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Shipment Alpha: weight 41 tons
* Shipment Beta: weight 31 tons
* Shipment Gamma: weight 59 tons
* Shipment Delta: weight 46 tons
* Shipment Epsilon: weight 42 tons
* Shipment Zeta: weight 54 tons
* Shipment Eta: weight 34 tons
* Shipment Theta: weight 52 tons
* Shipment Iota: weight 36 tons
* Shipment Kappa: weight 37 tons
* Shipment Lambda: weight 31 tons
* Shipment Mu: weight 52 tons
* Shipment Nu: weight 31 tons
* Shipment Xi: weight 41 tons
* Shipment Omicron: weight 55 tons
* Shipment Pi: weight 69 tons
* Shipment Rho: weight 30 tons
* Shipment Sigma: weight 50 tons
* Shipment Tau: weight 59 tons
* Shipment Upsilon: weight 65 tons

Each cargo plane can carry up to 100 tons. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Each shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total weight on a plane cannot exceed its capacity.
